# netmaker_node (Resource)

Joins an existing netmaker_device to a network, creating a Node. Does not install or configure anything on the device — it must already be running netclient (e.g. via netmaker_device); the running netclient picks up the new network automatically. Optionally turns the node into an ingress gateway (is_ingress_gateway) — the attach point for netmaker_ext_client's gateway_node_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) ID of the device (netmaker_device) to join to the network.
- `network` (String) Network to join.

### Optional

- `force_delete` (Boolean) Remove the node even if it has unresolved dependents (e.g. it's a relay/gateway other nodes depend on).
- `is_ingress_gateway` (Boolean) Whether this node is an ingress (remote-access) gateway — the attach point for netmaker_ext_client's gateway_node_id. Set to true to turn this node into a gateway on create/update; set to false to remove the gateway role.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `address6` (String)
- `connected` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned node ID.
- `is_egress_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_internet_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_relay` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
